mass_basis_mapping.definition: B_all,negative=U_all.T@D_unit@diag(norm(U_negative_j,Cartesian)); a rectangular mass-normalized old-basis mapping only, not a complete new Hessian.
mass_basis_mapping.units: Eh/Bohr^2/amu; no conversion to vibrational frequencies

false.curvature_units: Eh/Bohr^2; Cartesian subspace curvatures, not vibrational frequencies
false.interpretation: A symmetrized diagnostic candidate spectrum; antisymmetry is retained and this is not established as the physical energy Hessian.
false.selection_rule: Lowest ascending eigenpair of Ksym v=lambda Gv in this branch, regardless of sign; only the True branch supplies a diagnostic test candidate; normalize Qv in Euclidean Cartesian norm; max-absolute Cartesian component positive.
false.physical_interpretation: Diagnostic symmetrized spectrum of the rebuilt-grid False-gradient field, which need not be conservative; not an energy-Hessian spectrum.

selected_candidate.coefficient_basis: Euclidean-unit Cartesian columns Q_j=U_original_j/norm(U_original_j,Cartesian); the stored q and D*c use the identical phase- and norm-adjusted coefficients.
selected_candidate.branch_prediction_definition: Same fixed True-selected coefficients c for both D_false*c and D_true*c; False prediction does not use the False minimum eigenvector.
selected_candidate.selection_rule: Lowest ascending eigenpair of Ksym v=lambda Gv in this branch, regardless of sign; only the True branch supplies a diagnostic test candidate; normalize Qv in Euclidean Cartesian norm; max-absolute Cartesian component positive.
selected_candidate.limitation: Chosen diagnostic candidate regardless of eigenvalue sign or grid-set mismatch; symmetrization does not prove an energy Hessian or a full molecular minimum.

interpretation: Complete old-negative-mode directional cluster only; all source-bound qualified columns used, no physical minimum claim and no entire-matrix finite-step convergence claim.
